source.interpretation: OperationProfile.IQTYD may reference a user-defined IntegerDistributions.DISTID. Two <DETERM> components at 1 and 5 with PFAC=0.5 each define a two-point count candidate; native conversion and events must confirm support. The installed dictionary identifies <DETERM> for this table, resolving the broader manual's inconsistent predefined-distribution list.

exact_delta: OperationProfile.IQTYD changes <POISSON> to COUNT15; ITYPE=RANDOM, IQTY=3, IPER=12, IDISP=EQUIDIST and STIM=8 stay fixed.

One IntegerDistributions table is added with two COUNT15 rows: PFAC=0.5, BASED=<DETERM>, PARAM1=1 or 5. ProblemDescription.PDESC changes a provenance label; all 29 pre-existing other tables are unchanged.
predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH under the host-wide mutex preserves GUI PID 13340, seals immutable sources and raw outputs, completes import/export/calc/report, and has zero conversion errors with classified warnings.
Exact row-containing source import/export identity across 14 populated tables, including both IntegerDistributions rows; nonempty report and 72 aligned half-hour bins with NREP=32.
Do not infer all 32 aggregate replication counts from averaged bins or a one-group event log. If the aggregate log exposes one group, report only that group's count and timing.

A separately frozen 32-seed one-replication matrix must show each realized count is exactly 1 or 5, both values occur, and start times for count n follow 8+12*k/n for k=0..n-1. Each mission succeeds and completes two hours later; no cancellation, shortage, failure, repair or stock demand. Each seed report has NREP=1, 72 bins, 2n aircraft operation-hours and three ready at hour 36.

Report seed-level count mean, sample variance and nominal two-sided 95 percent Student-t mean half-width, targeting at most one mission. A separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event groups, statistics and ledgers without importing author validation.
limits: One two-point 1-or-5 user-defined integer distribution, one 12-hour equidistant period and 32 fixed convenience seeds. A finite sample cannot prove 0.5/0.5 probability or stream independence; zero-count and other distribution forms remain unverified.
GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
